definitions: A body of citizens, selected randomly, who are brought together to learn about and deliberate on a particular issue or set of issues, and to make recommendations.
A deliberative democratic innovation where a representative group of citizens is chosen by lot to study and make recommendations on public policy.
examples: The government established a citizens’ assembly to discuss climate change.
Recommendations from the citizens’ assembly were presented to parliament.
A citizens’ assembly can enhance public engagement in policy-making.
